description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rinoa (Ice)], [Angel Wing Extreme Damage Tracker] and [Angel Wing Extreme Level]

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rinoa (Ice)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Angel Wing Extreme (0~2), removed after using Angel Wing Extreme two times

description.name: Angel Wing Extreme Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Angel Wing Extreme level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rinoa (Ice)]

description.name: Angel Wing Extreme Level
description.text: Keeps track of Angel Wing Extreme level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rinoa (Ice)]
